description: This file defines an ApiClient class for making HTTP requests (GET and POST) to a backend API using configurable base URLs. It includes methods for handling responses, error handling, and constructing request URIs. It also defines an ApiException class for handling API errors.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A lightweight HTTP client for interacting with a backend API using a configurable base URL.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Exception class used for API errors, including HTTP status code and message.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP client and sets up the base URL.

methods.name: _normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes the base URL to ensure it does not end with a slash.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Builds a complete Uri object with path and query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response, decoding JSON or throwing an ApiException on error.

methods.name: _extractErrorMessage
methods.description: Attempts to extract a meaningful error message from the response body.
